sourcesPersonallyRead.locator: Full two-page USGS Fact Sheet 015-02. Page 1 states map/ground relationship, representative fractions use same units, gives 1:63,360 and 1:316,800 examples, explains larger denominator/smaller scale and 1:600 town engineer use. Page 2 states 1:50,000–1:100,000 covers more area with reasonable detail and smaller scales omit details.
sourcesPersonallyRead.assessment: Directly checked complete saved source context, not only quotations.
